notes: v465 — a green badge can no longer come from a signal that LOSES to the market. Audit found seven of nineteen graded rules underperform the market yet still wore SOLID or PROMISING, because the tier read the fire count and nothing else. Worse, the 🤖 auto-pilot already refused to buy those same signals — the radar and the robot were giving opposite verdicts. Now they agree: sample size still decides WHICH tier, but only signals that actually beat the market earn one at all. Shares firing only losing signals show ⚠️ underperforms — with the records named — instead of a green tick or a silent blank. Every ⚖️ chip now shows its edge on its face. Your SOLID count may drop; what's left is the part that was ever worth the name. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
